verdict.rationale: RustDesk's own documentation lists "file transfer in both directions" as a core session capability. The repository also includes a dedicated file copy-and-paste implementation for Windows, Linux and macOS. One hands-on report says clipboard file copy-paste from Linux to Windows did not work, which is a limited caveat on one platform path rather than a contradiction of the transfer feature. Missing for 10: in-depth first-party docs on the file transfer workflow and limits, independent confirmation that bidirectional transfer works reliably, and reliable Linux-to-Windows clipboard file copy.

support.subject: As a power user, I can transfer files between the host and the viewing device inside a session
